arStrings.szText: The dead spill forth, laying waste to the living. Three wander among them— {c_highlight}Tal Rasha, Sankekur, and Prince Aidan{/c}. The lost vessels of the Primes, still tormented by the {c_highlight}nightmares{/c} of their past. They must be found and laid to rest, as must others who plague the land. But you need not do it alone. An {c_highlight}old friend{/c} has returned to offer his help...
